description: Distance from grid is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Offgrid Market Opportunities. Select areas in the country that are at least a particular distance from the grid. Coverage: Nigeria, Tanzania, Zambia. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
